instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Management consulting firm serving mid-market companies with strategy, operational excellence, and digital transformation engagements. Team of 40 consultants across 3 offices. Typical engagements are 8-16 weeks. Evaluating knowledge management AI to capture and surface past engagement insights for proposal development. We have a dedicated management team across core functions but operate with limited middle management layers. Budget cycles are annual with moderate flexibility for mid-year reallocation if a strong business case is presented. Innovation initiatives compete with day-to-day operational demands for team attention.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine that has become our fastest-growing SKU.
answers.strategicGoals: We operate in a consolidating market where competitors are merging to gain economies of scale. Our independent position is increasingly vulnerable. We need to proactively strengthen our competitive positioning — either by deepening our specialization in high-margin niches where scale matters less, or by building platform-like switching costs that make our offering stickier for existing customers.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

input.changes_since_last: Post-merger integration underway. Team doubled to 2 members. Culture clash between legacy and new teams.

opportunities.title: Deepen Niche Specialization via Platformization of AI Assets
opportunities.rationale: To counter market consolidation, Prime must build deep switching costs. Leveraging the successful AI recommendation engine to hyper-specialize its application within 1-2 high-margin niches will create a defensible platform offering. This moves the firm beyond general consulting services.

first_actions: Identify 3 top-performing, highest-margin niche areas from past engagements.
Develop detailed product requirements for 'Niche X' modules built on the AI engine.
Establish a dedicated internal Product Council involving R&D and senior consultants to guide specialization efforts.
resources_needed: Dedicated 1-2 FTE developer time (ring-fenced from operational sprints)
Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in target niches
Proposal development templates for specialized services
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase average revenue per client engagement by X% within 12 months due to platform upsell.
milestones: Niche selection and feasibility assessment completed (Q+1)
MVP prototype for the first niche launched internally (Q+2)
Pilot sale of specialized service in target niche (Q+3)

opportunities.title: Standardize Knowledge Capture Post-Merger Integration
opportunities.rationale: The merger and resultant cultural clashes threaten knowledge coherence. Implementing a standardized, mandatory cross-functional review process will harmonize best practices and prevent valuable institutional knowledge from being lost or siloed between legacy teams.

first_actions: Draft a 'Knowledge Transfer Protocol' outlining required documentation for key project phases.
Conduct initial workshops with both legacy and new team members to identify process gaps.
Implement mandatory knowledge contribution points into the existing stage-gate process.
resources_needed: Updated internal wiki/knowledge base platform access
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in documented knowledge gaps cited during project handoffs by 30%.
milestones: Protocol drafted and approved by senior leadership.
Pilot run of the protocol on one active engagement.

next_steps.action: Formalize cross-departmental roles (RACI matrix) to clarify ownership following the merger integration.
Implement a mandatory 'Protected Innovation Block' of 1 day per team member/week, ring-fenced from billable operational demands.
Host a series of internal 'Niche Deep Dive' sessions, pairing R&D engineers with senior consultants to identify high-value platformization opportunities.

key_weaknesses: Cultural friction and integration misalignment between merged teams, hindering optimal collaboration.
Difficulty protecting dedicated time for strategic innovation due to high operational demands and immediate billing pressures.
Over-reliance on the specialized expertise of senior consultants rather than scalable, standardized platform assets.

improvements: The structured stage-gate process is maturing into a formal asset, evidenced by the successful launch of AI products contributing 18% revenue.
Execution capabilities were demonstrated with the successful completion and scaling of prior opportunities (Opp_2).
Management attention has shifted toward leveraging technology for market positioning rather than general service delivery.
persistent_gaps: The cultural integration and internal process harmonization remain significant soft barriers that require dedicated effort.
Lack of defined, protected time resources prevents the full realization of larger strategic innovation bets.
Strategic focus is still heavily tied to existing client needs rather than proactive market creation.
achieved_milestones: Successful deployment and scaling of AI-powered recommendation engine SKU.
Completion of defined objectives for prior initiatives (Opp_2).
Formal establishment of an innovation budget structure (5% revenue equivalent).

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has matured its formal innovation processes and successfully monetized new assets (AI engine), significantly increasing operational maturity compared to the prior assessment. However, internal friction (merger/culture) and resource allocation remain primary limiting factors.
